item.title: Paris : wave of demonstrations against colonialism, fascism and racism - Palestine - Kanaky - Clement MERIC
item.description:
Vidéo parue dans Contre-Attaque du 2 juin 2024
At the same time, the calls to demonstrate in solidarity with the Kanak people who are suffering the repression of the militias and the French state, and those for Palestine have aggregated, forming a real wave. A powerful convergence against fascism and colonialism took place this Saturday, bringing together a gigantic and determined crowd, which took the streets of the capital with great energy, held the police in check, deployed its colors eve
